definitions.explanation: The scientific study of matter, energy, and their interactions.
Relating to physical properties or phenomena rather than chemical ones.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}で{物理|ぶつり}を{専攻|せんこう}した。
examples.english: I majored in physics at university.

examples.japanese: {物理|ぶつり}{学者|がくしゃ}として{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: He is famous as a physicist.

examples.japanese: {高校|こうこう}のとき、{物理|ぶつり}が{一番|いちばん}{苦手|にがて}な{科目|かもく}だった。
examples.english: When I was in high school, physics was my weakest subject.

examples.japanese: {物理的|ぶつりてき}に{不可能|ふかのう}だ。
{物理的|ぶつりてき}な{距離|きょり}があっても、オンラインで{会議|かいぎ}ができる。
examples.english: Even with physical distance, we can hold meetings online.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}は{物理的|ぶつりてき}な{原因|げんいん}ではなく、ソフトウェアの{問題|もんだい}だと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think this problem is a software issue, not a physical cause.

notes:
USAGE: {物理|ぶつり} is commonly short for {物理学|ぶつりがく} (physics as a discipline).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{物理|ぶつり}{学|がく} (physics)
・{物理|ぶつり}{学者|がくしゃ} (physicist)
・{物理|ぶつり}{的|てき} (physical)
・{物理|ぶつり}{療法|りょうほう} (physical therapy)
・{物理|ぶつり}{現象|げんしょう} (physical phenomenon)
・{原子|げんし}{物理|ぶつり}{学|がく} (atomic physics)

RELATED SUBJECTS:
・{化学|かがく} (chemistry)
・{生物|せいぶつ} (biology)
